provenance.source: frozen blind prediction v1 of 't43_ref_z' (configuration 't43_ref'), Monte Carlo envelope of 200 Latin-hypercube runs (seed 20260925) over the tolerances of: driver_Re_ohm, driver_Mms_g, driver_Sd_cm2, driver_compliance_factor, driver_Bl_factor, driver_Rms_factor, driver_rear_boss_diameter_mm, diaphragm_setback_mm, lip_inner_diameter_mm, lip_thickness_mm, driver_gasket_mm, cup_inner_diameter_mm, pad_ring_width_mm, pad_ring_height_mm, gasket_compressed_mm, rear_depth_mm, back_plate_mm, rear_mesh_hole_diameter_mm, front_hole_diameter_mm, mesh_rayl, residual_leak_gap_mm, pinna_volume_cm3; protocol 'Open reference cup: measurement session (spec Section 17)'

notes: Columns: frequency_Hz; nominal, median, p5, p10, p90, p95, min, max in ohm; nominal, median, p5, p95, min, max of the phase in degrees; runs (successful Monte Carlo runs); shading (validity of the nominal solve: 0 none, 1 light, 2 dark; docs/netlist.md). Percentiles: linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy default). ITU-T P.57 Type 4.3 ear on a head and torso simulator, reference state. Overrides: {"drive_mW":0.01,"fidelity":1,"front_plug":"mesh","load":"type43","pinna_volume_cm3":10,"rear_plug":"mesh","residual_leak_gap_mm":0.05,"source_impedance_ohm":0}. Centre the cup on the ear canal entrance as far as the pinna allows, with 5 N of clamping force (headband or a calibrated spring). The pinna's acoustics are not modelled: the model sees it only as a volume taken from the front cavity (pinna_volume_cm3, an estimate) and a larger residual leak.
